data.text: Luke, I’m not going to ask my neighbors to empty the lake alongside you. Fishing has supported my family for generations; I want it to keep supporting yours, too. What concern is driving your demand—do you doubt the others will stick to equal shares? Let’s address that before anyone casts a net. I propose we record a 10-ton limit for each of us and meet after every month’s catch is revealed to check that everyone kept it. I’ll take 10 tons under that agreement. Will you join us, and if not, what would make a lasting agreement acceptable to you?
